O.outcome_detail: availability of postgraduate psychiatric training in intellectual disability

cells.quote: Out of the 42 countries surveyed in 2014, 41 (98% response rate) answered the questions on the availability of ID training (see Table 1). Twenty-three (56%) of the countries provided postgraduate psychiatric training on ID and 18 (44%) did not
cells.note: Descriptive cross-sectional survey; the contrast is between countries with and without postgraduate ID training, not a randomized educational comparison.
